# agenco_custom_masking_regex (Resource)

Manages a custom masking regex. Reference its ID from a masking policy's custom_masking_regex_ids to apply it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agenco_custom_masking_regex" "internal_order_id" {
  application_id = agenco_application.storefront.id
  name           = "internal_order_id"
  pattern        = "ORD-[0-9]{10}"
  flags          = "g"
  description    = "Internal order identifiers must not reach the model"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application this regex belongs to.
- `name` (String) Regex name.
- `pattern` (String) Regular expression used to detect the value to mask.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description of what the regex matches.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the regex is applied.
- `flags` (String) Regular expression flags, up to 4 characters, for example "gi".

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Custom masking regex ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import agenco_custom_masking_regex.internal_order_id 0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789/55556666-7777-8888-9999-000011112222
```
